text:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — Quantix just sent a completed SIG/CAIQ but flagged the POC needs an on-prem option and references HSM/KMS. They want answers and a copy back by Friday. Can someone triage and own?

sigbot: Created risk ticket RISK-4589 and added the SIG PDF to the ticket. https://redwood.internal/risk/RISK-4589 :white_check_mark:

Sasha (Security): I'll pick this up. Quick Q: do they need a full on-prem install or just KMS integration?

Maria (Sales): From the customer: "POC will run in our secure lab — we need either HSM-backed keys or a VPC/private deployment where we control keys." They also asked about data retention for prompt logs.

Alex (Security): Thanks. Can you attach the raw SIG PDF to the thread? Need to answer the crypto controls (KMS/HSM), logging retention, and data isolation controls. Also call out any answers that require legal / SOC artifacts.

Maria (Sales): Attached in RISK-4589 and here: https://drive.redwood/quantix/SIG-2026-03-20.pdf

Jamie (Support): Assigning preliminary owner: Sasha. ETA to initial pass = 48h (will mark TTR on the ticket). If Security needs test creds or a short network diagram from Quantix, loop back and we'll push. :spiral_calendar:

Tariq (Solutions): FYI — if they insist on HSM we have two patterns: 1) Customer-managed KMS + Redwood private deployment, or 2) Hosted with external HSM via partner integration (longer lead). Which path should we present?

Sasha (Security): Good call. I'll do a control-by-control pass. For now: flag controls that require legal (third-party attestations, cross-border data transfer, and BAA items). Will provide recommended answers and a short exceptions list.

Alex (Security): Also need to know whether they'll accept a compensating control for "service-side key custody" (i.e., customer supplied keys via Bring-Your-Own-Key). If not, HSM on-prem is contractual.

Maria (Sales): Quantix already said BYOK is acceptable in principle but prefers HSM. I'll confirm and report back. Also they're asking if we offer any POC credits or discounted dedicated capacity for the lab test.

Tariq (Solutions): Pricing note: for lab-level dedicated capacity we can offer a 30% POC discount for up to 2 weeks on a case-by-case basis. I'll draft an internal pricing note once Security signs off on the deployment model.

Sasha (Security): Early findings after first pass (summary):
- Controls flagged for legal: C-3 (third-party certs), C-11 (cross-border data), C-19 (BAA-specific handling)
- Action items: need quantized retention window for logs, network diagram for lab connectivity, confirmation on BYOK vs HSM, and sample data classification.

Alex (Security): Suggested text snippets for SIG answers (happy to paste into the form):
```
"Encryption-in-transit: All traffic to Redwood-hosted endpoints uses TLS1.3 with strong ciphers. For private deployments, we recommend TLS terminated at customer gateway."
"Key management: We support customer-managed keys (BYOK). For HSMs, we support customer-hosted HSMs in private deployments; hosted HSM integrations require additional SOW."
```

Sasha (Security): I'll upload the recommended snippets to RISK-4589 and mark which answers are "provided" vs "requires follow-up".

Maria (Sales): Thanks — please CC me when you mark "requires follow-up" so I can ping the customer. Quantix is sensitive to timelines.

Jamie (Support): Noted. If Quantix needs a short non-prod token or sample dataset to validate on-prem integration, we can provision that once Security signs the architecture notes.

Sasha (Security): Next steps: 1) I'll finish the control pass by EOD tomorrow, 2) tag legal for flagged items, 3) post final answers in RISK-4589 and update here.

Maria (Sales): Appreciate it. If anything blocks the Friday deadline we'll escalate on the deal. :pray:

Alex (Security): If legal will need >2 days, flag the item as "requires negotiation" so sales can set expectations.

Tariq (Solutions): Also adding: sample network diagram (minimal) attached for the team to review — shows private VPC peering pattern for on-prem lab. https://drive.redwood/quantix/network-diagram.png

Sasha (Security): Got it. Uploaded working draft of answers to the ticket. tagging: @Alex (Security) @Jamie (Support) @Maria (Sales).

Maria (Sales): Confirmed — I've told Quantix we're aiming for answers by Friday but may need an extra 48h on legal items. They'll wait for the full SIG back before the next exec call.

sigbot: RISK-4589 updated: security_owner=Sasha; status=In Review; sla=48h.

Sasha (Security): Closing update for now — initial SIG draft posted, putting blockers in RISK-4589. Will update thread once legal responds.

Maria (Sales): Awesome. Thanks team.
